# v1.1.0: Safer onboarding and broader route capture

Webapp Capture can now prepare an empty local or seeded app from an explicitly approved onboarding plan before it captures the interface. The preflight runs once before parallel screenshot or inventory workers, records every step before acting, and keeps the built-in secret-field and destructive-click blocks active.

## Added

- Recursive `crawl-links` discovery for apps whose routes are not all present in the first navigation view.
- Route caps, pathname allowlists, and route-family tab exclusions for controlled coverage.
- Ordered screenshot-manifest merging, with successful retries replacing earlier errors or truncated states.
- Optional project context files and onboarding evidence in Claude Design handoff archives.

## Improved

- Every tab capture starts again from the base route and resolves the current tab before clicking, preventing one tab from changing the next capture.
- Scroll capture favors substantial overflow regions and ignores short nested controls such as text areas.
- Token exports report the configured capture theme instead of assuming dark mode.

## Safety

- Onboarding is limited to local or seeded environments and requires explicit approval of the exact action plan.
- All actions are validated before navigation. Production onboarding is refused, live field attributes and values are checked before filling, and parent-directory output paths are rejected.
- Custom deny patterns add to the built-in destructive-action denylist instead of replacing it.
- Recursive discovery skips destructive-looking route segments, and Claude Design context files reject sensitive filenames, non-text formats, oversized files, and configured redaction-pattern matches.

## Requirements

- Node.js 20.9 or newer
- Chromium for Playwright
- FFmpeg for demo-video assembly
- A running local, staging, or synthetic demo application

## Downloads

- `webapp-capture-plugin-1.1.0.zip`: complete plugin for Claude Code and Cowork
- `webapp-capture-stinger-1.1.0.skill`: standalone skill for claude.ai
- `SHA256SUMS`: SHA-256 checksums for both artifacts

This prepares release artifacts and notes only. It does not publish a GitHub Release or create a tag.
